The diagram marks the arc measure corresponding to B to C as 146°, and angle 2 is located at point B, being the angle formed by tangent AB and chord BC. Then reason: According to the tangent-chord theorem, the measure of the angle formed by a tangent and a chord equals half the measure of its intercepted arc. Therefore m∠2 = 146° ÷ 2 = 73°.
